visual_prompt: A clean, modern medical-style illustration (soft painted, realistic proportions) on a warm cream background (#F7F1E6): the same body area of the problem shown twice side by side, split exactly in the vertical center. LEFT half = only «Sin ayuda»: the problem clearly visible (for example swelling shown as translucent blue fluid, or the area looking worse). RIGHT half = the result in the same area, clean and clearly better. Same framing, same scale and same lighting on both halves; the area fills 80% of the frame. Keep the bottom-right corner calm (the app places the product there). Realistic and tasteful: fully clothed (leggings, jeans or a fitted dress), never explicit. Do NOT show the product. Product context (Spanish, from the product sheet): product: «VITALDROPS»; audience: «18 a 55»; problem: «Como y como y no me engorda nada»; result: «».
language_rule: No visible text at all: the app adds every text.
